title: no usable Node: the not-running screen says what is missing and how to fix it

checks.label: says Node 22+ is needed and none was found
checks.detail:
The Tandemise daemon is not running

Tandemise needs Node.js 22 or newer to run its daemon, and none was found. Install it from nodejs.org or with Homebrew (brew install node), or set TANDEMISE_NODE to the path of a Node 22+ binary, then press Retry.

Looking for the handshake file at
/tmp/tdm-retry/home-no-node/daemon.json
Retry

Tandemise will try to start the daemon for you. If that keeps failing, start it by hand with npm run daemon and press Retry.
